These are nests you can crochet and knit and donate to your local wildlife rehabilitation organization. I have lots of yarn scraps I intend to use for this project.

Wildlife rehabbers don't typically get a lot of funding and these donated nests would go a long way to help them care for their birds and animal babies.

Tips:

Don't use novelty yarns like fake fur, fuzzy or metallic yarns because the birds' feet may get tangled in the loops.

Ensure that the nest is tightly knit or crochet so the animals' legs and feet don't get caught in the loops and weave.
